name: The Prank
source:
"The Prank" follows the story of three college friends who team up to pull a prank on their coach. Each has their own personal reason for wanting to get back at the coach, making this the perfect opportunity to settle the score and have some fun along the way.

But their plan takes an unexpected turn, and they find themselves caught red-handed by the Coach. Now, the tables have turned, and the friends must think quickly to avoid disciplinary action. Each of them must plead their case, hoping their words will sway the Coach's judgment.

What will they say? How far will they go to defend themselves? That’s for you to decide. 

[From [url=https://pelted-pixel-games.itch.io/the-prank]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《恶作剧》讲述了三个大学好友联手恶作剧他们的教练的故事。每个人都有自己想要报复教练的个人原因，这使得这是一个算账并一路享受乐趣的绝佳机会。

但他们的计划发生了意想不到的转变，他们发现自己被教练当场抓住了。现在，形势已经逆转，朋友们必须迅速思考，以免受到纪律处分。他们每个人都必须为自己的情况辩护，希望他们的话能够影响教练的判断。

他们会说什么？他们会走多远来保护自己？这由你决定。

[来自[url=https://pelted-pixel-games.itch.io/the-prank]Itch.io[/url]]
